data.name: Nitheesh
data.gender_notes: Nitheesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nitheesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nithi' which means consciousness. This name is given to a boy who is believed to be the embodiment of consciousness and awareness. It is a powerful name that signifies wisdom, enlightenment, and the power to overcome obstacles. The name Nitheesh carries the meaning “Lord of Consciousness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Nitheesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of consciousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nitheesh is a name given to a child who is believed to be a manifestation of the divine consciousness. It is a name that signifies wisdom, enlightenment, and the power to overcome obstacles. It is a name that is deeply spiritual and is often given to children who are destined to become spiritual leaders or teachers.
data.etymology: Nitheesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Consciousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nitheesh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Nitheesh was a famous Chola commander in the late 10th century. He is mentioned in the 'Chola Chitambaram' inscription of Rajaraja Chola I (1012-1018 CE) as a victorious general, who conquered the Kongu country in the south Indian subcontinent.
historical_references.context: Nitheesh is a revered name in Tamil Hindu history for his military conquests during the Chola Dynasty.

historical_references.reference: Nitheesh is also mentioned in the 'Tiruvalangal Alvar Tirumozhi' (a Tamil language text attributed to the 6th-7th centuries CE) as a devotee of Lord Shiva. He is referred to as 'Nitheeswaran', a title derived from his name, and is praised for his devotion and dedication to the Lord.
historical_references.context: Nitheesh is also a venerated name in Hindu mythology for his unwavering devotion to Lord Shiva.
